bi-privacy.84d7038fced7: Buffett Indicator · Buffett Indicator & Shiller PE
bi-privacy.d4b1f2aa10d1: Effective November 14, 2026 · Applies to the Buffett Indicator (iOS) and Buffett Indicator & Shiller PE (Android) mobile apps.
bi-privacy.784d95b81eab: We collect a small, stated set of data. Your email and basic Google profile if you sign in, any feedback you send, your answer to the "enjoying the app?" prompt, basic device details (app version, OS version, device model, language) and a push-notification token. Section 2 lists each item.
bi-privacy.d311f46ecf22: No third-party analytics, no tracking, no ads. We count review-prompt answers and read feedback in our own database to improve the apps, but we use no analytics, crash-reporting or ad SDKs, do not track you across apps or websites, and collect no advertising identifier.
bi-privacy.1918dc219f47: No subscriptions or in-app purchases. The apps do not process any payments.
bi-privacy.f82df712cd9f: We never sell your personal data. We never have, and we have no plans to.
bi-privacy.81d484c02780: You can delete your account anytime. Email us and we will remove your account and associated data.
bi-privacy.b91480f71135: Questions? Email team@deepvalues.ai — we read every privacy request and reply as soon as possible.
bi-privacy.9e3f382479a7: This Privacy Policy applies to the following apps operated by Lulu Ventures LLC ("Lulu Ventures," "we," "us," "our"):
bi-privacy.84f1f6a91a8f: Buffett Indicator & Shiller PE is the Android version of our Buffett Indicator app (earlier published on Google Play as "Bubble Watch"). The iOS version is distributed as "Buffett Indicator." Both apps provide the same market indicator content and follow the same privacy practices described here. References to "the app" below apply to both.
bi-privacy.629166b6ffc1: We collect the following, and nothing else:
bi-privacy.f67780c57339: Email address (if you sign in) — used to identify your account and to contact you about essential service matters. You can also add an email address to a feedback message so we can reply.
bi-privacy.2e07cf0682c2: Google Account basic profile (if you sign in) — when you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and (if available) your profile picture from Google. We request only the basic profile and email scopes.
bi-privacy.e8ba5edc509d: Account identifier — the Firebase user ID created when you sign in. It is attached to feedback and review-prompt answers you send while signed in.
bi-privacy.1cf24967f847: Feedback you send — the text you write in the in-app feedback form. It is stored in our database and emailed to our team so we can read and answer it.
bi-privacy.b2a6b8e471eb: Review-prompt answers — the apps occasionally ask whether you are enjoying them. On Android, your answer (like, dislike or later) is sent to us every time you answer, whether or not you are signed in. On iOS, your answer is sent only if you go on to submit the feedback form.
bi-privacy.44531674e152: Device details — app version and build, operating-system version, device model and language. These are sent with feedback and review-prompt answers and stored with your push-notification registration, so we can tell which versions and devices a report or answer comes from.
bi-privacy.01339b9eeea1: Push-notification token — a token from Firebase Cloud Messaging that lets us send the market alerts you choose. It is stored with your account together with your notification settings.
bi-privacy.871cecc9140b: Margin of Safety Weekly subscription — if you sign in, your email address is used to send the Margin of Safety Weekly, an informational email about market valuation. It is part of the service, not marketing, and you can stop it at any time with the unsubscribe link in every email, in the app's settings where available, or by emailing us.
bi-privacy.378c2700b28b: No advertising identifier. Neither app contains advertising, and neither collects your device's advertising ID.
bi-privacy.583218190d15: We do not collect your contacts, precise location, photos, device sensors, browsing activity, crash logs, payment details, or any other personal information beyond what is listed above.
bi-privacy.c8b000f5f048: We use the information we collect only to:
bi-privacy.f160d96fe22e: Create and authenticate your account so you can sign in securely.
bi-privacy.6205ef24ba72: Provide the market indicator content that the app exists to deliver.
bi-privacy.b6c1f3694ff2: Send the market alerts you turn on, using your push-notification token.
bi-privacy.f84f054cbafe: Communicate with you about essential, account-related matters (for example, responding to a support or privacy request), and send the Margin of Safety Weekly unless you turn it off.
bi-privacy.e823e0a04e6e: Improve the apps — we read your feedback and count review-prompt answers by app version, device and language in our own database. This is first-party measurement only; it is not shared with analytics providers and is not used to profile you.
bi-privacy.aebe2c0ed365: Keep the service secure and prevent abuse of accounts.
bi-privacy.5e7f986b43c6: We do not use your information for advertising, profiling, or to train any AI or machine-learning models. Your sign-in data — your email and Google profile — is never used for advertising.
bi-privacy.59ee3a5b3253: No advertising. Neither the iOS app (Buffett Indicator) nor the Android app (Buffett Indicator & Shiller PE) contains ads or ad networks.
bi-privacy.e31d949831bd: No third-party analytics or crash tracking. The apps contain no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising SDKs (such as Firebase Analytics or Crashlytics). The only usage information we receive is the review-prompt answers, feedback and device details described in section 2, which are stored in our own database.
bi-privacy.0e0291800587: No behavioral tracking by us. We do not track you across other apps or websites, and your sign-in data is never used to profile you.
bi-privacy.85f8d9f3aaa4: No subscriptions or in-app purchases. The apps do not process payments and do not collect billing or payment information.
bi-privacy.7a91e6f0e22b: No sale of personal data. We never sell your personal data. We share your information with no advertising or analytics third parties.
bi-privacy.70b3f14e056c: We do not sell your personal data. Our apps and your account data are hosted on Google (Firebase) in the United States, which also provides "Sign in with Google" authentication.
bi-privacy.b4e6d855103a: Advertising. Neither app displays advertising. We use no ad networks, collect no advertising identifier and share no data with advertising partners.
bi-privacy.1261a21edf02: Feedback messages are also delivered to our team's email inbox. Apart from this hosting, authentication and email delivery, we do not share your information with anyone else, except when required by law.
bi-privacy.65ab9ede0a34: Account data (your email and Google profile basics) — kept while your account is active, and deleted within 30 days of an account-deletion request.
bi-privacy.adf30f05e439: Support correspondence and feedback — kept only as long as needed to resolve your request and meet our legal obligations.
bi-privacy.18cda4d4c18a: Review-prompt answers and device details — kept only as long as they are useful for improving the apps; those linked to your account are deleted with it.
bi-privacy.365931b98556: Push-notification tokens — kept while notifications are registered on the device, and deleted with your account.
bi-privacy.276db8093846: Backups — encrypted backup copies are overwritten on a rolling basis, within 90 days.
bi-privacy.85183f2e5894: No matter where you live, you can:
bi-privacy.4b2cf300fbc2: Access the personal data we hold about you.
bi-privacy.d81dddf24c22: Delete your account and associated data (see section 8).
bi-privacy.59a2976815ad: Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
bi-privacy.0f5a1e024f64: Residents of California, the other US states with comprehensive privacy laws, the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland have additional statutory rights (such as portability and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority). To exercise any right, email team@deepvalues.ai. We read every request and reply as soon as possible, and you will not be treated differently for exercising a privacy right.
bi-privacy.db48cd772bb7: You can request deletion of your account and all associated personal data at any time. Email team@deepvalues.ai from the address associated with your account, with the subject "Delete my account." We will permanently delete your email and Google profile data, along with the feedback, review-prompt answers, device details and push tokens linked to your account, and confirm once it is done. Deletion is permanent and propagates to backups within 90 days.
bi-privacy.fd0a309414dc: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest.
bi-privacy.9b0836ec6303: Account sign-in is handled through Google's authentication; we never see or store your Google password.
bi-privacy.56908edf7a34: Access to stored account data follows the principle of least privilege and is restricted to authorized personnel.
bi-privacy.e882645426a6: No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information using industry-standard safeguards.
bi-privacy.2d2bab72656e: The app is rated 4+ on the App Store, meaning its content is suitable for all ages. It is an informational market-indicator tool and is not directed at children as its audience. Signing in requires a Google Account, which Google requires account holders to meet a minimum age for (generally 13, or older in some regions).
bi-privacy.86dc7aa6d7e5: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (in compliance with COPPA), or under 16 where that is the applicable age of digital consent. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, email team@deepvalues.ai with the subject "Child data deletion" and we will remove it promptly.
bi-privacy.ffeb5bc4ab5c: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in the apps, our practices, or the law. When we make material changes, we will update the "Effective" date above and, where appropriate, provide additional notice. Your continued use of the apps after an update means you accept the revised policy.
